definitions.gloss: each department; every section (in an organization)
definitions.explanation: A reference to all departments or sections within a company or organization, used when addressing or involving multiple divisions collectively.

examples.japanese: {各部署|かくぶしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通知|つうち}した→通知する：19645_tsuuchisuru⟧。
{各部署|かくぶしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{会議室|かいぎしつ}→会議室：01265_kaigishitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: The person in charge from each department gathered in the conference room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}→導入：10127_dounyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧あたり、{各部署|かくぶしょ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募|つの}った→募る：10878_tsunoru⟧。
examples.english: In preparation for introducing the new system, we solicited opinions from every department.

notes:
Combines ⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧ (each, every) + ⟦{部署|ぶしょ}→部署：08187_busho⟧ (department, section). A standard business term used in internal communications and company-wide announcements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {各部署|かくぶしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧: to contact each department
- {各部署|かくぶしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧: representative of each department
- {各部署|かくぶしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{共有|きょうゆう}する→共有する：19639_kyouyuusuru⟧: to share across all departments

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {各部門|かくぶもん}: each division — used for larger organizational units than 部署
- {全部署|ぜんぶしょ}: all departments — emphasizes totality rather than each individually
